name: Kuroda Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells goods and materials for data storage, automotive, and electronics industries in Japan and internationally. It offers printing plates for alignment film printing for liquid crystal panels; automated assembly and inspection equipment; ultrasonic soldering devices; aluminum die-casting products; and assembly equipment for disk drives.
